svg.aria-label: Detection lab traffic flows between zones
svg.title: Detection lab traffic flows between zones
svg.text: Detection lab · how traffic travels between zones
Hosts always send untagged frames. The bridge port or switch port applies the VLAN tag, and OPNsense is the only router between zones.
1 · WS01 → DC01: inter-VLAN traffic that never leaves the host
2 · WS01 → internet: NAT out through the WAN and the trunk
3 · Kali → DMZ web: the physical attacker reaches the lab through the trunk
4 · Kali → DC01: blocked by default deny, and the block is a detection signal
The firewall log entry feeds the SIEM.
5 · Admin laptop → Proxmox UI: management bypasses OPNsense by design
Proxmox stays reachable even when the OPNsense VM is down (DD-010).
Inter-VLAN rules shown are the planned policy (firewall rules not written yet).
